request.question: My Bluetooth headset won't pair with my laptop anymore. It shows connected for a second and then drops.
request.answer: I am sorry to hear you are having trouble with your Bluetooth headset. 1. Forget the headset in Bluetooth settings. 2. Put it into pairing mode, usually by holding the power button for 5 seconds. 3. Pair it again while keeping it within one metre of the laptop

documents.text:
## Fix
Forget the headset in Bluetooth settings, put it into pairing mode (usually hold the power button for 5 seconds), and pair again. Keep it within one metre of the laptop while pairing.
